links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM triage of messages into non-urgent, urgent, emergent; over- and under-estimation rates
links.effect: Trial 1: 140 (93%) correct, 4 (3%) overestimated, 6 (4%) underestimated. Trial 2: 140 (93%) correct, 9 (6%) overestimated, 1 (1%) underestimated. Accuracy did not depend on urgency level (p = 0.19).
links.quote: In the first trial, ChatGPT correctly triaged 140 (93%) messages, overestimated the priority of 4 messages (3%), and underestimated the priority of 6 messages (4%).

links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM triage across repeated runs two weeks apart
links.effect: Internal agreement of ChatGPT responses was 92% with intra-rater Kappa of 0.88.
links.quote: The internal agreement of ChatGPT responses was 92% with an intra-rater Kappa score of 0.88.

screen.reason: The study evaluates ChatGPT-4's triage performance on 150 simulated nephrology inbox messages compared against physician triage, without evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
